$comment: Curated featured apps per family. Every domain was checked over HTTPS on 2026-10-03 (status 200, or a redirect to the listed domain). Apps on a family whose module hasn't landed are hidden by the service until that family is switched on. Trade & earn entries (category "trade"): regulated products Clip Wallet never offers itself; each domain was checked over HTTPS on 2026-10-03 except polymarket.com, which is DNS-blocked from the checking network (Philippines), so it is listed from Polymarket's own docs and press; every one connects through an injected EIP-6963 wallet or WalletConnect (sources: docs/phase25/integration/extensibility.md).
